card.name: Zero ending a threshold number
card.fires_on: The digit 0 completing a round tens number (30, 40, 50, 80) right after 'less than', '<' or '>' in weight, kidney function or lab cutoffs.

modes.label: Weight cutoffs
modes.description: The 0 in a body-weight limit in kg after 'less than' or '<'.

modes.label: Kidney function cutoffs
modes.description: The 0 in a CLCr or eGFR limit before mL/min.
modes.example: patients with a CLCr less than 5<<0>> mL/min. 2.4 Prevention

card.plain: It fires on the final zero of a round cutoff number, such as less than 50 kg or eGFR below 30.
